mapper.sql: SELECT p.id AS participant_id, p.training_id, p.uid, p.status AS participant_status, p.join_time, p.gmt_create, p.gmt_modified, u.username, u.nickname, u.realname, COALESCE(ur.hist_rating, 0) AS hist_rating, COUNT(DISTINCT uap.pid) AS solved_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_problem all_tp WHERE all_tp.tid = p.training_id) AS total_count FROM training_participant p LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.uuid = p.uid LEFT JOIN user_record ur ON ur.uid = p.uid LEFT JOIN training_problem tp ON tp.tid = p.training_id LEFT JOIN user_acproblem uap ON uap.uid = p.uid AND uap.pid = tp.pid
mapper.select: WHERE p.uid = #{uid} GROUP BY p.id, p.training_id, p.uid, p.status, p.join_time, p.gmt_create, p.gmt_modified, u.username, u.nickname, u.realname, ur.hist_rating ORDER BY p.gmt_create DESC
